note: Mail that has NOT been reconciled into data/ledger/baseline.json. It is the thing 'Run now' applies, so the demo can show reconciliation happening rather than describing it. Deliberately kept out of data/corpus/messages.json: scripts/build-ledger.mts reconciles every message in that file, so anything in it is already applied by the time the page renders. messages.beat: Marcus delivers the two outstanding vendors on the day he promised. Closes c009 outright, and should complete c004 as well, which has been partially_satisfied since the 22nd. Two rows moving from one message is the clearest thing reconciliation does, and it is the reason this message says 'that is the full thirteen' rather than only naming the two. Dated the demo's today (meta.today = 2026-09-23) so it reads as mail that just arrived. Carries no new promise of its own, so nothing new should be extracted from it - if a row appears, extraction has over-read an apology.
